legend.environment.loadFailed: Failed to load; the map shows no data: {message}
legend.environment.hollowSea: Sample out of date or none taken
legend.environment.hollowManual: Discontinued, or no valid sample in the last 12 months
legend.environment.hollowEffluent: Data stale (not updated for over 3 hours)
legend.environment.hollowCems: Data stale (over 6 hours) or status not provided
legend.environment.hollowUv: Missing value, or not updated for over 2 days
legend.environment.seaNote: Color shows the marine area class (set by designated use), not how good a single sample was; the popup shows all parameters from the latest sample. Sampled about every quarter. Ocean Affairs Council · Open Government Data License, version 1.0
legend.environment.rpiSegTidal: Confirmed tidal reach (dashed; RPI is less representative)
legend.environment.rpiSegNote: Rivers with stations nationwide: an upstream station represents the reach down to the next station, so this is not continuous monitoring; rivers without stations are not colored, which does not mean they are clean. River-name reassignments, inferred flow directions and other items pending review are listed in the popup. Same colors as the RPI stations. Centerlines {attribution}
legend.environment.pm25Note: Manual filter weighing, about one daily average every 3 days; not real time. Colors share a source with the five PM2.5 classes of the micro sensors. Coordinates are those of the air quality station with the same name, not the sampler's actual location. Ministry of Environment
legend.environment.dioxinNote: Regular sampling about 1–2 times every six months; not real time. Color shows relative level only and is not compared with any standard. Coordinates are those of the air quality station with the same ID. Ministry of Environment
legend.environment.incinNote: Reported monthly (delayed by about 1–2 months). Color shows only the relative level of NOx; the dataset carries no emission standard, so no exceedance is judged. Dioxins (ng-TEQ/Nm3), particulate matter (mg/Nm3; mostly not reported) and opacity (%) are in the popup. Ministry of Environment
legend.environment.gammaTitle: Environmental radiation (Nuclear Safety Commission) · dose rate
legend.environment.gammaRedBox: Red outline: ≥{value} μSv/h, above normal background
legend.environment.gammaNote: Normal background is about 0.04–0.14 μSv/h; updated every 15 minutes. This is a different station network from the Taipower nuclear plant perimeter radiation (Hazard · Nuclear Safety). Nuclear Safety Commission
legend.environment.effluentNote: Color priority: stale → over limit → abnormal → normal. Exceedance follows the upstream status "over limit"; updated hourly. Click a point to see all parameters. Ministry of Environment
legend.environment.cemsNote: Hourly values, with the upstream source delayed by about 4–5 hours. A facility counts as operating if any one of its stacks is running normally; over-limit follows the upstream status code "value over limit". Ministry of Environment
legend.environment.uvNote: Previous day's maximum; not real time; updated daily. Central Weather Administration
legend.environment.pollSeverityNote: Regulated ≠ polluted | facility color = highest severity
legend.environment.penaltyNote: Major-case dot size ∝ fine | white outline = repeated / suspension etc. | year playback available
legend.environment.truckNote3d: Parked / offline dots are smaller; trucks on collection give off music notes
legend.environment.windClick: Click anywhere on the map to read wind speed and direction
legend.environment.oceanClick: Click anywhere on the sea surface to read current speed and direction
legend.environment.dustSub: Dust aerosol optical depth (AOD) 0–1, fixed color scale (comparable across time; transparent = no dust)
legend.environment.aqiDesc1: Acceptable; slight effect on sensitive groups
legend.environment.aqiDesc2: Sensitive groups should reduce outdoor activity
legend.environment.aqiDesc3: The general public should reduce outdoor activity
legend.environment.microNote1: Temperature (°C) · same color scale as Temperature Grid 2D
legend.environment.microFoot: LASS AirBox / Ministry of Environment micro sensors · latest 15-minute snapshot
legend.environment.urbanNote0: Relative to the low-elevation farmland background; negative values mostly reflect high elevation and do not mean a cool city
legend.environment.urbanNote1: Multi-year warm-season median at 10:20 a.m. · land surface temperature is not air temperature
legend.environment.urbanCredit: Landsat 8/9 land surface temperature · 2019–2025 warm-season composite · USGS
legend.environment.urbanCoverage: Penghu is not included (no upstream data)
legend.environment.waveSub: Air temperature (stretched to the day's observed range)
legend.environment.waveNote: Wave height follows temperature | for absolute °C classes turn on Temperature Grid 2D
legend.environment.h3Note: Relative color scale (the maximum in view = 100%) | the contrast slider changes the distribution
legend.environment.wasteFacNote: Turn on "3D effect" to add 3D shapes (chimneys, domes, radar, etc.).
legend.environment.lightningCwaNote2: Time to the minute only; no current intensity
legend.environment.lightningCwaNote3: Runs alongside the Taipower source so the two can be compared
legend.environment.noiseOfficialSource: Ministry of Environment dataset 28185 and local noise monitoring sources
legend.environment.noiseOfficialNote: The energy average of the "actually reported samples" within the latest available 30-day window of each source; use it together with the active-day coverage in the popup. It is not a complete continuous monthly mean or a regulatory compliance judgment. Stations without a verified dB value are kept, and a hollow dot does not mean quiet or 0 dB.
legend.environment.noiseCaptureNote: Citizen-science observations, not statutory noise measurements. z7–10 uses 1 km (1 cell), z11–12 uses 500 m (1 cell), z13–15 uses 250 m (3 cells); the three scales are mutually exclusive and highly sparse. Blank does not mean quiet or 0 dB; the quality threshold has not been relaxed.
legend.environment.noiseControlSource: Taichung City Environmental Protection Bureau · Open Government Data License, version 1.0
legend.environment.noiseControlNote: Class 1 to Class 4 are statutory control classes, not measured sound levels. v1 has only Taichung's official 2024 (ROC 113) polygons; blank outside Taichung does not mean there are no control zones. Some official geometries were topologically repaired; the statutory boundaries were not redrawn or inferred.
legend.environment.aviationSource: Taoyuan / Kaohsiung City Government announced lists + NLSC 2026-06-26 village boundaries
legend.environment.aviationNote: An overlay of administrative boundaries on the statutory village membership list; it is not a measured DNL noise contour, and does not mean noise is the same everywhere within a village. v1 covers only Taoyuan / Kaohsiung; when the source does not state an effective date, none is inferred.
legend.environment.enforceSource: Ministry of Environment EMS_P_46 pollution penalty data
legend.environment.enforceNote: Color shows penalty severity and dot size can reflect the fine; it is not a dB observation or sound intensity. Positioning precision is mixed; the data reuses the existing pollution_penalties PMTiles and is not a live feed of citations.
legend.environment.cameraSource: Official lists of the Tainan City / Changhua County Environmental Protection Bureaus · Open Government Data License, version 1.0
legend.environment.cameraNote: Only 267 of the 333 listed entries can be drawn; 66 pending entries are not filled in with administrative-area centers. A position may be an address, a road section or a fuzzy location; the list does not indicate live operation, violation locations or dB. v1 covers only Tainan and Changhua.
legend.environment.gbPaLandscapeHeading: Landscape designations (large areas, light fill, drawn underneath)
legend.environment.gbPaAonb: Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty (National Landscapes in England)
legend.environment.gbPaSssi: Site of Special Scientific Interest (ASSI in Northern Ireland)
legend.environment.gbPaOverlap: One site often carries several designations (e.g. SSSI + SAC + SPA + Ramsar); use "Designations" to show one group
legend.environment.gbPaNiNoPark: Northern Ireland: no national parks exist under its law
legend.environment.gbPaScotlandNsa: Scotland: no AONBs; National Scenic Areas are used instead
legend.environment.gbWoodCleared: Temporarily unstocked (felled, ground prep, windblow, failed)
legend.environment.gbWoodNiNote: Northern Ireland is not covered by the NFI survey: DAERA's priority habitat woodland inventory is shown instead, which DAERA says is incomplete, so gaps do not mean no woodland
legend.environment.gbWoodZoom: Shown from zoom 8 (large file, not loaded at low zoom)
legend.environment.gbTrailNational: National Trails (incl. Wales Coast Path, from zoom 6)
legend.environment.gbTrailUnclassified: Unclassified (Scottish and Welsh sources have no category)
legend.environment.gbTrailScotland: Scotland: national forest routes only (Great Trails and Core Paths not included)
legend.environment.gbOaNote: Open to walkers on foot; seasonal or temporary restrictions may apply
legend.environment.gbOaScotland: Scotland: not applicable (statutory access rights apply to most land)
legend.environment.gbTreeTree: Protected tree (TPO individual tree or canopy)
legend.environment.gbTreeTpoCoverage: TPOs come only from English local authorities in the Planning Data pilot ({zones} for zones, {trees} for trees); everywhere else is not covered, so a blank area does not mean there is no TPO
legend.environment.gbTreeAncientCoverage: Ancient woodland: England, Scotland, Wales; Northern Ireland not covered
legend.environment.gbTreeZoom: Ancient woodland from zoom 9, TPOs from zoom 12
legend.environment.gbPlanViewNote: Conservation areas are shown by default; use the “Category” menu for Article 4, green belt or all. Green belt is drawn with a light fill because the areas are large
legend.environment.gbPlanEnglandOnly: Article 4 and green belt: England only (published by individual councils in Scotland and Wales; not included)
legend.environment.gbBfNote: Each point is the representative point of one registered site (not its boundary), individual points from zoom 10; fill strength shows permission progress
legend.environment.gbBfCoverage: England only (the brownfield land register is an English system); Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland not covered
legend.environment.gbRecHeatNote: The density layer counts recycling bins only; recycling centres are drawn as points at every zoom
legend.environment.gbRecOsm: OSM gap-fill: the whole layer comes from OpenStreetMap (there is no official national list of recycling points), so completeness varies by area
legend.environment.gbRecCoverage: Coverage 4/4: England {e}, Scotland {s}, Wales {w}, Northern Ireland {ni}
legend.environment.gbWasteAuthorities: England EA {ea}, Scotland SEPA {sepa}, Northern Ireland NIEA {niea}; filter with the “Regulator” menu
legend.environment.gbWasteWales: Wales: not covered (the NRW licence does not allow public release)
legend.environment.gbWastePersonal: Sites run by individuals are excluded; permit holders are not shown
legend.environment.gbWasteEaLicence: England EA data is used under the EA Conditional Licence (one year from 2026-10-29)
legend.environment.gbPolReleased: Reported releases to air or water ({n})
legend.environment.gbPolNone: No release on any reported route ({n}, hollow)
legend.environment.gbPolScotland: Scotland: SEPA Scottish Pollutant Release Inventory (SPRI), {year} returns, {n} sites
legend.environment.gbPolEngland: England: licence under review, not shown for now
legend.environment.gbNoiseSourceNote: Use the “Noise source” menu to switch between road ({road} polygons) and rail ({rail} polygons); shown from zoom 9
legend.environment.gbNoiseNote: Strategic noise model estimate (day–evening–night Lden at 4 m above ground), not measured; below 55 dB not mapped
legend.environment.gbNoiseCoverage: Northern Ireland: not covered; Wales rail: not covered
legend.environment.gbNoiseRounds: England and Scotland are Round 4 (2022, vectorised from a 50 m grid); Wales is 2017 (Round 3) and not directly comparable
